findings.notes: Two panes. Inbox/Archived tabs and search box. The empty state reads 'No conversations yet'. Rows show the other participant's avatar, the subject or names, relative time and a 'Pam: …' sender preview. Unread rows are bold (font-weight 700) with a count badge (4). Newest activity sorts first. Minor (UIV-4): when the last message is deleted, the preview shows 'This message was deleted' with no sender prefix.

Sender avatar, name and time on each message. A day divider ('Monday 9 November 2026') uses the school timezone (America/New_York). The attachment renders through FileList (homework-note.txt, 20 B). The '(edited)' marker and an italic 'This message was deleted' render. Shift+Enter newlines are preserved. Upward infinite scroll (30 per page) was not exercised in the UI because the fixtures had fewer than 30 messages. QA covers it at the service level.

Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a newline. The counter '4600 / 5000' appears past 4,500 characters. Send is disabled at 5,001. 'Attach files' with a '0 / 5' limit indicator; the uploaded file is sent as a message attachment.

Multi-select 'To' picker fed by the contacts endpoint and grouped by label, plus 'Subject (optional)' and 'Message'. Send creates the conversation, closes the dialog (0 dialogs open 2.5 s later) and navigates to /messages/[id].

Parent sees "My child's teachers (Sam)" and 'School office'. Student sees 'My teachers' and 'School office'. Searching for another student gives 'No one you can message matches'. A direct API create between two students returns 403.

findings.surface: Student reply in a staff-created group
findings.notes: A student can reply in a teacher-created group. Student-to-student creation is refused (see FR-8).

findings.surface: Composer when the relationship has ended
findings.notes: A student whose enrollment was set to DROPPED sees an info Alert, 'You can no longer send messages in this conversation.', in place of the composer. The API send returns 403. The teacher can still send in the same group.

A message sent in the parent's browser appeared in the teacher's open thread in about 5.35 s (5 s poll), within the 6 s limit. The 30 s list and badge polling was not timed in the UI. The badge cleared after a reload.

The menu offers Mute, Archive and View participants. Mute is saved (mutedAt set). After a reload, the list row shows a bell-off icon and the menu shows 'Unmute'. Archive shows the toast 'Conversation archived', removes the row from Inbox and lists it under Archived. Unarchive works. The Participants dialog lists names with role chips. Opening the thread sets lastReadAt and clears the sidebar badge. Minor: UIV-3 (the muted icon's aria-label is hidden from assistive tech), UIV-5 (the 'Conversation muted' toast didn't show while an earlier toast was still visible).

A student in a group sees 'Leave group' with a confirm dialog. After leaving, the conversation is gone from the list, and reopening its URL gives 404. The teacher who created this student group is not offered 'Leave group'.

Message options lead to Edit, then an inline editor and Save, then '(edited)'. Delete opens a confirm dialog ('Everyone in the conversation will see "This message was deleted"'), then the message shows as deleted. A message older than 15 minutes has no options button, and a late PATCH returns 403.

Teacher: 'Message parents' on /students/[id] opens the dialog prefilled with the linked parent (Pam Parent). Parent: 'Message teacher' opens the dialog limited to the "My child's teachers (Sam)" group.
The button is disabled until a student is selected. 'Select all' gives the dialog prefilled with both students. Sending creates a 3-participant group with involvesStudent=true.
Present for PARENT, TEACHER, STUDENT and ADMIN at 1280 px, and in the 375 px hamburger nav. The badge ('N unread conversations') shows for an unread conversation and clears after reading.

'Quiet hours' section with Start and End time fields and a school-timezone hint (America/New_York). 22:00–07:00 (wrapping past midnight) saved and persisted after a reload. No horizontal scroll at 375 px.

Message options lead to Report, which opens the 'Report message' dialog with a reason field. Submitting shows the toast 'Reported — the school will review this.'. The user's own messages have no Report item.

The safeguarding lead sees the nav entry. The queue lists the OPEN report with an orange chip. The detail drawer shows the reason, participants, and 5 messages of context either side with the 'Reported' highlight. 'Mark reviewed' is disabled until a note is entered, and the status changes to REVIEWED. A non-lead admin gets no nav entry, the page redirects to /forbidden, and the API returns 403. See FAIL UIV-1 for the drawer header.

findings.surface: Safeguarding report detail drawer — header/Close button
findings.notes: UIV-1: the temporary right Drawer (z-index drawer=1200) opens beneath the fixed AppBar (z-index drawer+1). The drawer header holding the 'Report' title and the Close button is covered: elementFromPoint at the Close button returns the app bar, and the click times out. The user can only close the drawer with Esc or a backdrop click. Fix: add `sx={{ zIndex: (t) => t.zIndex.modal }}` to the Drawer in SafeguardingReports.tsx:181.

The Conversations tab has Participant and Active from/to filters. It lists only student conversations: the student group is listed and the parent↔teacher thread is not. The read-only view has no composer. It shows the deleted body with a 'Deleted <time>' chip, an 'Edited' chip and the original text under 'Earlier versions'. 'Open full conversation' appears only when a student is involved. Without a student, the safeguarding view returns 404.
Each view added a 'safeguarding.conversation.view' AuditLog row (1→2 in the main run, 2 in the supplementary run).
The safeguarding lead's bell shows an unread badge (1) after the report. Seen in the screenshots; the notification payload was not inspected in the UI.

findings.surface: isSafeguardingLead on the admin user form
findings.notes: There is no admin user edit form in this codebase. ADR-11, accepted at intake, makes PATCH /api/users/:id the only way to set the flag, so there was nothing to render. QA verified the flag at the API level.
At 375 px, /messages shows only the list, and /messages/[id] shows only the thread with a 'Back to conversations' arrow that returns to the list. No horizontal page scroll (0 px).
All rendered surfaces use MUI components: List, Tabs, Autocomplete, Dialog, Drawer, DataGrid, Alert, Chip and Snackbar. No unstyled raw HTML seen.
Same evidence as FR-13: about 5.35 s, within the 6 s limit, with no websockets.

defects.summary: The report detail drawer opens under the fixed AppBar, so the 'Report' title and Close button are hidden and can't be clicked
defects.fix: Add sx={{ zIndex: (t) => t.zIndex.modal }} to the Drawer

observations.detail: axe on /messages and /account/notifications: list (serious) x1-2, because ListItemButton renders as <a> directly inside <ul> without <li>. Also heading-order (moderate) and region (moderate); the region rule is an app-wide pattern. /admin/safeguarding gave color-contrast (serious) x1 in one of the runs.
The muted icon in a conversation row has aria-label='Muted', but MUI SvgIcon sets aria-hidden without titleAccess, so screen readers don't announce the muted state. Use titleAccess="Muted".
The list preview for a deleted last message is 'This message was deleted' with no 'sender:' prefix. Product should decide whether it should read 'Pam: This message was deleted'.
The 'Conversation muted' toast did not appear while the earlier 'Reported…' toast was still showing (shared toast behaviour). The mute itself succeeded.
Not exercised in the UI: upward infinite scroll at 30 per page, 30 s list/badge poll timing, the 25-participant cap message, and deferred email delivery (FR-20). QA covers these at the service level.

Production CSP (script-src 'self', next.config.js) blocks Next's inline hydration scripts under `next start`. This is pre-existing (ADR-4), and the existing E2E specs use bypassCSP. Verification used bypassCSP: true. Without it, no client UI hydrates in production.
The in-memory per-IP login rate limit (10 per window) forced a server restart between driver runs. Expected behaviour.

method.build: npm run build (exit 0), served with next start -p 3300 against Postgres :5433. The :3000 and :3001 servers were left untouched.
method.driver: Throwaway Playwright scripts outside the repo: /tmp/uiv-sh13/driver.cjs and supp.cjs. Tagged fixtures uiv-sh13/uiv-sh13s: safeguarding-lead admin, non-lead admin, teacher, parent linked to student 1, 2 students, and 1 course. All were removed afterwards (0 remaining).
method.designReference: figma-readiness.json is absent, so the comparison is against requirements.json only.
